Salt lowers the temperature at which water freezes. Road crews spread it in winter so that a thin film stays liquid instead of turning to ice. The effect fades as the temperature drops further, and grit is added for grip.

Paper is made from wood fibers that are pulped, drained on a screen, pressed and dried. The fibers line up with the run of the screen. That is why a sheet tears straight along one edge and ragged along the other.
